channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Iran media say ‘enemy’ projectiles hit Sirik areas
item.description: Tehran says ready for dialogue with nations in the region to 'foster mutual trust' and 'achieve sustainable security'.

item.title: Trump says the US-Iran war will end right after midterms
item.description: Seven months after launching the war on Iran, US President Donald Trump says it will end immediately after midterms.

item.title: Iran war looms over Trump at Republican midterm convention in Dallas
item.description: Trump supporters say he can rally Republican voters despite concerns over the unpopular war and rising prices.

item.title: Liverpool come back to beat Atletico Madrid 2-1 in Champions League opener
item.description: Marcos Llorente gives Atleti an early lead but Liverpool strike back through Dominik Szoboszlai and Alexis Mac Allister.

item.title: Trump says Iran war ‘will end immediately’ after US midterm elections
item.description: The president added the US is not looking to restart negotiations with Iran after the failure of previous ceasefires.

item.title: IAEA board refers Iran to UN Security Council over nuclear ‘non-compliance’
item.description: The symbolic escalation has been initiated by the United States, Germany, France and the United Kingdom.

item.title: Yemen envoy warns of wider war as Houthis threaten Bab al-Mandeb Strait
item.description: In an interview with Al Jazeera, Yemen's ambassador warns Houthi attacks threaten global shipping.

item.title: Israeli strike targets home in Gaza’s al-Shati refugee camp
item.description: An Israeli strike devastated a home in Gaza City’s al-Shati refugee camp, heavily damaging surrounding homes.

item.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
item.description: Brent crude - the global benchmark for prices - rises after the US hit five Iranian tankers on Tuesday

item.title: Iran referred to UN Security Council for nuclear non-compliance
item.description: Tehran condemns the resolution, blaming US and Israeli strikes on its nuclear facilities for disrupting inspections.
